```{r, warning=F}


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 11.1 Import Data


# Gene matrix
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_data_dir, "vst_oof.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F, row.names = 1
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")

# ENSG -> gene symbol mapping
ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
) %>%
  { setNames(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )

# Protein matrix
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F, check.names = F
)

# LASSO fold coefficients: gene workflow
lasso_coefs_gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)

# LASSO fold coefficients: protein workflow
lasso_coefs_prot <- read.csv(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "lasso_fold_coefs.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)

# Metadata
metadata_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(gene_data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = F
)






# 11.2. Correlation density plot


plot_width <- 6.5
plot_height <- 6.5

plot_font <- "Arial"
plot_font_size <- 16

shared_genes <- intersect(
  full_vsd$gene_symbol,
  colnames(protein_mat)[-1]
)

cat(
  "Shared analytes:",
  length(shared_genes),
  "\n"
)






# 11.2a Compute per-analyte Pearson r


cor_per_gene <- full_vsd %>%
  filter(gene_symbol %in% shared_genes) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "expr_rna"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_name,
        patient_id
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    protein_mat %>%
      { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
      mutate(
        patient_id = as.integer(patient_id)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -patient_id,
        names_to = "gene_symbol",
        values_to = "expr_protein"
      ) %>%
      filter(gene_symbol %in% shared_genes),
    by = c(
      "patient_id",
      "gene_symbol"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    pearson_r = cor.test(
      expr_rna,
      expr_protein,
      method = "pearson"
    )$estimate,
    p_value = cor.test(
      expr_rna,
      expr_protein,
      method = "pearson"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

summary(cor_per_gene$pearson_r)


median_r <- median(
  cor_per_gene$pearson_r,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

iqr_r <- IQR(
  cor_per_gene$pearson_r,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat("IQR =", round(iqr_r, 3), "\n")






# 11.2c. Density plot of per-analyte Pearson r


p_density <- ggplot(
  cor_per_gene,
  aes(x = pearson_r)
  ) +
  
  geom_density(
    fill = "#4C72B0",
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median_r,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = median_r + 0.03,
    y = Inf,
    label = paste0(
      "Median r = ",
      round(median_r, 3)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 14 / 2.845,
    family = plot_font
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.9),
    breaks = seq(-0.4, 0.8, 0.2)
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
  labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "RNA-protein concordance",
    x = "Pearson correlation coefficient",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = plot_font_size,
    base_family = plot_font
  ) +
  
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = plot_font,
      size = plot_font_size
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = plot_font_size
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "plain"
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "plain",
      size = plot_font_size
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )


# Export to PDF

ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "(3A)_correlation_density_plot.pdf"),
  plot = p_density,
  width = plot_width,
  height = plot_height,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

# Save Figure 3A plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  p_density,
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3A.rds")
)






```
